Senior Backend Engineer — Streamline Analytics

The team
Our Data Platform team owns the ingestion, transformation, and serving layers that power Streamline's real-time analytics products. We process over 80 billion events per month and serve thousands of customers from Fortune-500 enterprises to fast-growing startups. The team is small (8 engineers, growing to 14 this year), highly autonomous, and ships to production daily.

What you'll own
- Design, build, and operate Python services running on AWS (Lambda, ECS, RDS, SQS) that handle high-throughput data pipelines
- Lead architectural decisions for our next-generation event ingestion pipeline; you'll be a primary author of the design RFC
- Mentor junior and mid-level engineers via code review, pairing, and design feedback
- Carry on-call rotation for the services you own; participate in blameless postmortems
- Partner with product managers and analytics customers to translate ambiguous requirements into shippable specs
- Drive observability improvements (Datadog, OpenTelemetry, structured logging) across the platform

Requirements
- 5+ years of professional software engineering experience, with at least 3 years in Python
- Production experience with AWS services (Lambda, ECS, RDS, S3, SQS or similar)
- Deep understanding of relational databases (PostgreSQL preferred); query optimization, indexing strategy, schema design
- Hands-on experience operating high-throughput services (10K+ requests/sec or 1B+ events/day)
- Experience with infrastructure-as-code (Terraform, CloudFormation, or CDK)
- Strong written communication; you've authored design docs that shaped team direction
- Track record of mentoring more junior engineers

Bonus points
- Experience with Go for high-performance services
- Background in event-driven architectures (Kafka, Kinesis, or similar)
- Open-source contributions to data tooling
- Experience reducing AWS spend through rightsizing or architectural changes

What we offer
- Competitive base + equity + performance bonus
- Remote-first with team meetups in Austin twice yearly
- $2,000 annual learning and conference budget
- Comprehensive health, dental, vision, and 401(k) match
- Sabbatical after 4 years
